**Tier 4** — decisions — policies, overrides, scenarios · owned by `policy-ui` · `public.model_validation_evidence`

**One row is** The evidence one Validated Model rests on, kept beside it rather than summarised into it: per-KPI warm-up series and detector outputs, the replication analysis, the per-KPI tests, the face-validation statement and the evidence runs. One row per model, written with it, never edited (WP 10.3, §4 D243).

| Columns | Source | Constraint |

| `id` | column PRIMARY KEY | `model_validation_evidence_pkey` |
| `validation_id` | column UNIQUE | `model_validation_evidence_validation_id_key` |

| Row-level security | enabled |

Written only by `_insert_validated_model`, inside the same transaction as its model; a BEFORE UPDATE trigger refuses every edit. Read through `has_project_access`, and by the browser through `get_validated_model_evidence`, which is no wider than the model row it belongs to (readable by every API role). Audited at statement grain.
